description: API Gateway now supports two new security policies for REST APIs and custom domain names, SecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-Ext2-PQ-2025-09 (TLS 1.3 1.2 with post-quantum cryptography) and SecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-Ext2-FIPS-PQ-2025-09 (adds FIPS). Both retain legacy algorithms for backward compatibility.
